relations.subject: Tsikey Chokling Rinpoche
relations.evidence: He was the master of Vajrayana ceremonies at Ka-Nying Shedrup Ling monastery and of several other monasteries in Nepal.

relations.subject: 16th Karmapa
relations.evidence: Tulku Urgyen Rinpoche, a Tibetan Dzogchen meditation teacher who counted the 16th Karmapa among his students.

relations.subject: Tsikey Chokling Rinpoche
